seo.title: Book an Appointment | Aakash Eye Hospital
seo.description: Book an eye care visit at any Aakash Eye Hospital in Gujarat. Choose your hospital, the reason for your visit and a day that suits you - the request is sent on WhatsApp and the hospital confirms your slot.

label: Book an appointment
title: Tell us when,
lede: Five short questions. We write the request for you; you send it on WhatsApp and the hospital replies to confirm.

who.label: Who
who.title: Who is the visit for?
who.lede: The name the hospital will call out, and the number it will reply to.

where.label: Where
where.title: Which hospital suits you?
where.lede: Every hospital books its own appointments and answers its own WhatsApp.

what.label: What
what.title: What brings you in?
what.lede: Choose the closest match. If you are not sure, say so - the desk will guide you.

when.label: When
when.title: When would you like to come?
when.lede: Optional. The hospital confirms the exact time with you.

send.label: Send
send.title: Anything the desk should know?
send.lede: Optional. A line about your concern, an old case file number, or who is coming with you.

name.label: Patient name
name.error: Please enter the patient's full name.

phone.label: Mobile number
phone.hint: The hospital replies on WhatsApp to this number.

service.error: Choose a reason for your visit.
service.unsureHint: Tell us the concern and the desk will route you

date.label: Preferred day
date.closedNote: {closed} is not offered here: the {branch} OPD is {closedNote}.
date.error: Choose an open day ({days}), from today onwards.

message.label: Short message
message.placeholder: For example: cataract in the left eye, seen here in 2019.

nav.callLabel: Prefer to talk? Call the {branch} OPD

slip.note: This opens WhatsApp with the message written for you. Nothing is sent until you press send there.
slip.sentNote: Sent from your WhatsApp. The hospital replies to you there.

after.title: Your request is in WhatsApp.
after.lede: Press send there if you have not already. The {branch} desk replies during OPD hours to confirm your slot.

message.heading: *Appointment request - Aakash Eye Hospital, {branch}*
message.closing: Please confirm a slot. Thank you.
